messages:
Evan: thinking about a compact 'railway' row in Console that surfaces per-route telemetry + a quick quota estimate. idea: default sampling presets (1%, 5%, 10%) visible inline and a one-click 'save view' that preserves sampling. what do folks think?
Priya: +1. Need to see p50/p95 latency, token cost, and success rate. also where does sampling happen — frontend or backend?
Lena: backend. prefer adding a sampling query param to analytics API rather than sampling in UI. e.g. GET /api/v1/analytics/route/:id?sampling=0.05&window=1h
Samir: cautious — our router currently aggregates at the shard level every 10s. if sampling=0.01 we need consistent weighting. prefer server-side sampler at ingress so we can tag events and preserve attribution to quota buckets.
Evan: agreed. proposal: router sets header X-Telemetry-Sample and ingestion uses that to weight metrics. UI will surface an "estimated" badge and show error bars for sampling variance.
Priya: UX for saved queries: when saving a sampled view, show a small notice that sampling persists and offer a "preview full" button that runs with sampling=1.0 for one-off cost.
Lena: for quotas we should show an inline "project quota impact" calc: estimated token cost for the selected time window using modelRates endpoint (GET /api/models/:id/rates). show a tooltip explaining the estimate and assumptions.
Samir: API contract suggestion: extend saved_view to include sampling_rate and estimated_cost_per_hour. Keep backward compatibility: omitted sampling_rate defaults to 1.0.
Evan: important: when a route is pinned to a dedicated model variant we must save model_version_id (immutable) not just model alias. otherwise saved views drift during rollouts.
Priya: yup. add tooltip: "Pinned version = snapshot of model at save time. Alias may change." :information_source:
Lena: design: compact railway row should be 3 columns: sparkline (last hour), badges for p50/p95 + error, and a quota bar with inline actions (Open, Save, Pin). keep height 40px for dense lists.
Samir: implementation blocker: runtime currently doesn't always emit model_version in traces. need a small change to kernel instrumentation to tag model_version on requests. otherwise show 'version: unknown' in UI.
Evan: i'll ping @eng-infra and file an infra ticket. for immediate beta, we can ship with 'estimated' labels and fallbacks. any objections to launching a beta behind a feature flag?
Priya: :thumbsup: ship behind flag, notify customers.
Samir: +1. add unit tests for sampling weighting and a smoke test comparing sampled vs full counts.
Evan: quick saved_view schema snippet we can use in the API docs:
```json
{
  "id": "string",
  "route_id": "string",
  "filters": "string",
  "sampling_rate": 0.05,
  "pinned_model_id": "string",
  "estimated_cost_per_hour": 12.34
}
```
Lena: nice. also add a UI affordance that warns if a saved view's estimate would exceed project quota in the last 24h.
Priya: small localization/wording nit: "Estimated cost" > "Potential cost" is clearer.
Evan: good call. i'll update the mockups. i'll also draft the API PR and a feature-flagged frontend prototype. thanks all.
Samir: will volunteer to review the API PR and add the infra test.
Evan: thanks — leaving notes in the ticket after standup. :rocket:
